items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Rodriguez, our band master, he also played at night.

ctx.x: So I was way across town and, you know, and so I said, well--I walked home then. And I--I kept that in mind, man. And at that time we had a--my teacher, my science teacher who's an alto saxophone player. He played in--at night. And he would come to work in class, man, and he would--he was a very good teacher but he would take nods, you know, between, you know, uh, speeches and stuff, you know. He could tell you what's happening, you know, he'd give you your assignment, what to do, but I used to watch him going to…
at night. And also the--Mr. Rodriguez, our band master, he also played at night. He worked, he worked at a night club.
